messages.subject: Copynumber library not found
messages.body_plain:
Hi, I am trying to make dockerfile for sequenza from scratch. and I keep getting the error that copynumber package is not available.
I am using R version 3.5.1, also tried it on my local machine in R studio. Do you know what may be the issue here, or you maybe have example of Dockerfile for building sequenza docker?

Thanks

messages.subject: Re: Copynumber library not found
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

yes, as you can see in the repository o the sequenza docker image
https://bitbucket.org/sequenzatools/sequenza_docker

I’m calling an Rscript to install the dependencies. it's important to add the bioconductor repository to have copynumber, the line is:

setRepositories(graphics = FALSE, ind = 1:6)

I hope this help.

Best

Francesco

messages.subject: missing positions by bam2seqz
messages.body_plain:
Dear Francesco,

I have a list of mutations which are called by MuTect, and I would like to get estimates of local copy number and genotypes of these mutations from Sequenza. However some positions of these mutations are missing after running bam2seqz. I am attaching toy examples of normal and tumor pileup files here. I cannot attach hg19.gc50Base.txt.gz. If it is needed, I can load it into gDocs.

Here is my command line:
>sequenza-utils bam2seqz -q 20 -f sanger -gc hg19.gc50Base.txt.gz -p -n testNormal.pileup.gz -t testTumor.pileup.gz -o test.seqz

The output file has only the first position:
>cat test.seqz
>chromosome      position        base.ref        depth.normal    depth.tumor     depth.ratio     Af      Bf      zygosity.normal GC.percent      good.reads      AB.normal       AB.tumor        tumor.strand
chr1    16269595        C       194     389     2.005   0.79    0       hom     54      386     C       T0.21   T0.58

I went through the code, but couldn't figure out the reason why only the first position is reported. If I remove the first mutation from the original pileup files, the new result reports the new first position from the new file.

Please help me to solve this mystery.

Thanks a lot!

Yan
